task.title: Review profile context
task.shortdesc: Check profile identity, lifecycle, schema channel, validation state, and source context before finishing work.

prereq.p: Open BPM in the browser and keep a profile, Library, All settings, Guided, JSON, or Compare surface available.

context.p: Profile context prevents accidental edits to the wrong profile, wrong Firefox channel, archived row, imported source, or stale tab.

step.cmd: Read the profile name, lifecycle status, schema channel, and last updated context.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Check whether the current value came from manual edit, baseline, CIS, import, or raw fallback when source attribution is shown.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Review validation state and warnings before export or comparison.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: If context conflicts with the intended task, stop and reopen the profile from the Library.

info.note: Save or deliberately discard changes before leaving an editor, closing a tab, or confirming an irreversible action.

result.p: You can explain what profile you are editing and which constraints apply to it.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the visible state is unclear, stop editing, read the current status message, refresh once, and reopen the profile from the Library.
